_about: action pages a reviewer rejected, with why; seo/scripts/plan-actions.mjs never proposes these again

paths./integrations/excel/create-comment: microsoft graph beta, work or school accounts only, not for production
paths./integrations/excel/insert-range: too fine-grained for a non-technical reader
paths./integrations/github/create-a-release: maintainers only; publishes by default without asking
paths./integrations/github/list-notifications-: needs a classic personal access token; fails on the managed sign-in
paths./integrations/github/list-pull-requests: developer inventory; find pull requests covers the real question
paths./integrations/google-calendar/get-event: needs an internal id; find event covers it
paths./integrations/google-calendar/update-goo: near-duplicate of patch event and riskier
paths./integrations/google-drive/list-file-rev: returns only ids and dates, nothing usable
paths./integrations/slack/download-slack-file: makes a public link to the file, even for a read-only bot
paths./integrations/slack/find-users: a lookup step for other actions, not a job
